name: Ayasato Maiko
source:
Misty Fey was the Master of the Kurain Channeling Technique and head of the Fey clan.

[SPOILER]
Though the Master of the Kurain Channeling Technique was usually the eldest daughter of the previous Master, Misty gained the position as her spiritual powers were far greater than those of her older sister [url=https://vndb.org/c14378]Morgan[/url].

She was as an important figure in the DL-6 Incident, in which the police called her in to channel the spirit of [url=https://vndb.org/c14120]Gregory Edgeworth[/url], leading to the arrest of [url=https://vndb.org/c14295]Yanni Yogi[/url]. The conclusion of Yogi's trial and [url=https://vndb.org/c10882]Redd White[/url] leaking Misty's involvement to the press tarnished the reputation of the Fey clan. Misty went missing for 17 years until she was discovered, post mortem, to have become a popular children's book author by the name of Elise Deauxnim. She, while channelling her niece [url=https://vndb.org/c14412]Dahlia Hawthorne[/url], was killed by [url=https://vndb.org/c14420]Diego Armando[/url] whilst foiling a plot to kill her youngest daughter, [url=https://vndb.org/c3944]Maya[/url]. 

With her oldest daughter, [url=https://vndb.org/c3942]Mia[/url], having been killed prior, Misty's role as Master of the Kurain Channelling Technique was succeeded by Maya.
[/SPOILER]

[Based on her [URL=http://aceattorney.wikia.com/wiki/Ace_Attorney_Wiki]Ace Attorney Wiki[/URL] page.]
